title.zh: 卷九十四 列傳第二十四: 耶律化哥 耶律斡臘 耶律速撒 蕭阿魯帶 耶律那也 耶律何魯掃古 耶律世良
title.en: Volume 94 Biographies 24: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, Yelu Shiliang
title.raw: 卷九十四 列傳第二十四: 耶律化哥 耶律斡臘 耶律速撒 蕭阿魯帶 耶律那也 耶律何魯掃古 耶律世良 Volume 94 Biographies 24: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, Yelu Shiliang

sentences.zh: 耶律化哥耶律斡臘耶律速撒蕭阿魯帶耶律那也耶律何魯掃古耶律世良

translations.literal: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, Yelu Shiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Huage, Yelu Wola, Yelu Susa, Xiao Aludai, Yelu Naye, Yelu Helusaogu, and Yelu Shiliang.

sentences.zh: 耶律斡臘，字斯寧，奚叠剌部人。

translations.literal: Yelu Wola, courtesy name Sining, was a man of the Xi Diela tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Wola, whose courtesy name was Sining, came from the Xi Diela tribe.

sentences.zh: 趫捷有力，善騎射。

translations.literal: He was nimble and strong, skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: Quick and powerful, he excelled at riding and shooting from horseback.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，補護衛。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning, he was appointed to the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era he entered service in the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 車駕獵頡山，適豪豬伏叢莽，帝射中，豬突出。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage hunted on Jieshan, a giant boar happened to lie in ambush in the thickets; the emperor shot and hit it, and the boar burst forth.
translations.idiomatic: On a hunt at Jieshan Mountain, a giant boar lay hidden in the brush; the emperor struck it with an arrow, and the wounded beast charged out.

sentences.zh: 禦者托滿舍轡而避，廄人鶴骨翼之，斡臘復射而斃。

translations.literal: The charioteer Tuoman let go the reins to evade; the groom Hegu shielded him, and Wola shot again and killed it.
translations.idiomatic: The charioteer Tuoman dropped the reins to swerve aside, the groom Hegu threw himself in protection, and Wola loosed another shot that brought the boar down.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉賞。

translations.literal: The emperor commended and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 及獵赤山，適奔鹿奮角突前，路隘不容避，垂犯蹕。

translations.literal: When hunting Red Mountain, a fleeing stag suddenly charged forward tossing its horns; the path was narrow and escape impossible, about to strike the imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: On another hunt at Red Mountain, a startled stag lowered its antlers and charged; the trail was too narrow to dodge, and the beast was on the verge of striking the imperial procession.

sentences.zh: 斡臘以身當之，鹿觸而顛。

translations.literal: Wola placed his body in the way; the stag struck him and he fell.
translations.idiomatic: Wola threw himself in its path; the stag struck him and knocked him to the ground.

sentences.zh: 帝謂曰：「朕因獵，兩瀕於危，賴卿以免，始見爾心。」

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "Through hunting I twice came near death; relying on you I was spared—now I see your heart."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told him, "Twice on the hunt I stood at the edge of death, and twice you saved me—now I know where your loyalty lies."

sentences.zh: 遷護衛太保。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Senior Guard Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Senior Commissioner of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 從樞密使耶律斜軫破宋將楊繼業軍於山西。

translations.literal: He followed Privy Council Director Yelu Xiezhen in defeating the Song general Yang Ye's army in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Privy Council director Yelu Xiezhen in crushing the Song commander Yang Ye's forces in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 統和十三年秋，為行軍都監，從都部署奚王和朔奴伐兀惹烏昭度，數月至其城。

translations.literal: In autumn of the thirteenth year of Tonghe, he served as Field Army Chief Overseer, following Chief Deployment Commissioner Xi Prince Heshuonu to attack the Uyar Wuzhaodu; after several months they reached his city.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Tonghe 13 he was made chief overseer of the field army and marched with the deployment commissioner, the Xi prince Heshuonu, against the Uyar leader Wuzhaodu; several months passed before they came to his stronghold.

sentences.zh: 昭度請降。

translations.literal: Wuzhaodu requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhaodu offered to submit.

sentences.zh: 和朔奴利其俘掠，令四面急攻。

translations.literal: Heshuonu coveted the booty and captives and ordered attacks on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Heshuonu, eager for captives and plunder, ordered a fierce assault from every side.

sentences.zh: 昭度率眾死守，隨方捍禦。

translations.literal: Wuzhaodu led his forces in a stubborn defense, resisting on every side.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhaodu rallied his people in a desperate defense, beating back attacks wherever they struck.

sentences.zh: 依埤堄虛構戰棚，誘我軍登陴，俄撤枝柱，登者盡覆。

translations.literal: Along the ramparts they erected false fighting sheds to lure our troops onto the battlements, then swiftly removed the support posts, and all who climbed were crushed.
translations.idiomatic: Along the parapets they built sham fighting platforms to lure our men onto the walls, then pulled away the props; every climber was buried beneath the collapse.

sentences.zh: 和朔奴知不能下，欲退。

translations.literal: Heshuonu knew he could not take the city and wished to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the city could not be taken, Heshuonu wanted to pull back.

sentences.zh: 蕭恒德謂師久無功，何以藉口，若深入大掠，猶勝空返。

translations.literal: Xiao Hengde said: "The army has been long without success—what excuse can we offer? If we penetrate deep and plunder heavily, that still beats returning empty-handed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hengde argued, "We have campaigned for months without victory—what face can we show on our return? A deep raid with heavy spoils is still better than going home empty-handed.

sentences.zh: 斡臘曰：「深入，恐所得不償所損。」

translations.literal: Wola said: "A deep penetration—I fear the gains will not compensate the losses."
translations.idiomatic: Wola replied, "If we push deep inland, I fear what we gain will not repay what we lose."

sentences.zh: 恒德不從，略地東南，循高麗北鄙還。

translations.literal: Hengde would not listen; they raided southeast, returned along Korea's northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Hengde would not heed him. They ravaged the southeast and marched back along Goryeo's northern border.

sentences.zh: 道遠糧絕，人馬多死。

translations.literal: The road was long and provisions exhausted; many men and horses died.
translations.idiomatic: The march was long, supplies ran out, and men and horses died in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 詔奪諸將官，惟斡臘以前議得免。

translations.literal: An edict stripped the generals of their offices; only Wola was spared on account of his earlier counsel.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped the commanders of rank; only Wola was spared because he had argued against the raid.

sentences.zh: 尋加同政事門下平章事，為東京留守。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Associate Director of the Directorate for Affairs of State and concurrently Eastern Capital Garrison Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made associate director of the Directorate for State Affairs and appointed garrison commander of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 開泰中卒。

translations.literal: He died during the Kaitai era.
translations.idiomatic: He died during the Kaitai period.

sentences.zh: 耶律速撒，字阿敏，性忠直簡毅，練武事。

translations.literal: Yelu Susa, courtesy name Amin, was by nature loyal, upright, austere, and practiced in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Susa, courtesy name Amin, was loyal and forthright by nature, austere in manner, and thoroughly trained in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 應歷初，為侍從，累遷突呂不部節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yingli, he became an attendant, and was repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of the Tülübu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yingli reign he entered the emperor's entourage and rose step by step to military commissioner of the Tülübu tribe.

sentences.zh: 歷霸、濟、祥、順、聖五州都總管，俄為敦睦宮太師。

translations.literal: He successively held the post of Chief Commander of the five prefectures Ba, Ji, Xiang, Shun, and Sheng, and soon became Grand Master of the Dunmu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as chief commander of the five prefectures Ba, Ji, Xiang, Shun, and Sheng, and was soon made grand master of the Dunmu Palace.

sentences.zh: 保寧三年，改九部都詳穩。

translations.literal: In the third year of Baoning, he was changed to Chief Commander of the Nine Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoning 3 he was reassigned as chief commander of the Nine Tribes.

sentences.zh: 四年，伐党項，屢立戰功，手詔勞之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, campaigning against the Tangut, he repeatedly won battle honors; the emperor wrote him a personal edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, on campaign against the Tangut, he won repeated victories; the emperor sent him a personal edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 統和初，皇太后稱制，西邊甫定，速撒務安集諸蕃，利害輒具以聞，太后益信任之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tonghe, when the Empress Dowager held regency and the western frontier had just been settled, Susa devoted himself to pacifying and gathering the various fan tribes, reporting benefits and harms in full whenever they arose, and the Empress Dowager trusted him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: When Tonghe began, the empress dowager ruled as regent and the western frontier had only just been pacified; Susa worked to settle the frontier tribes and reported every advantage and risk in full, and the empress dowager came to rely on him still more.

sentences.zh: 凡臨戎，與士卒同甘苦，所獲均賜將校。

translations.literal: Whenever he took the field, he shared hardship with the soldiers and distributed booty equally among officers.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he took command he shared the soldiers' hardships, and whatever was captured he divided evenly among his officers.

sentences.zh: 賞順討逆，威信大振。

translations.literal: He rewarded the obedient and punished rebels; his authority and prestige rose greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded those who submitted and punished rebels, and his authority and reputation spread far.

sentences.zh: 在邊二十年卒。

translations.literal: After twenty years on the frontier he died.
translations.idiomatic: He served on the frontier for twenty years and then died.

sentences.zh: 那也為人廉介，長於理民，每有鬥訟，親核曲直，不尚威嚴，常曰：「凡治人，本欲分別是非，何事迫脅以立名。」

translations.literal: Naye was by nature incorruptible, skilled at governing the people; whenever there were lawsuits he personally examined right and wrong, did not rely on severity, and often said: "In governing people, the aim is to distinguish right from wrong—why force and coerce to build a reputation?"
translations.idiomatic: Naye was upright and incorruptible, and excelled at governing the people; whenever disputes arose he judged the rights and wrongs himself, without leaning on intimidation, and often said, "The point of governing people is to tell right from wrong—why browbeat them merely to build a reputation?"

sentences.zh: 胡所至以惠化稱。

translations.literal: Wherever he went he was acclaimed for benevolent transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served he was praised for ruling through kindness.

sentences.zh: 耶律何魯掃古，字烏古鄰，孟父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Helusaogu, courtesy name Wugulin, was a descendant of the Mengfu house.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Helusaogu, whose courtesy name was Wugulin, was a descendant of the Mengfu branch of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 重熙末，補祗候郎君。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongxi, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Chongxi era he was appointed an attendant gentleman.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，加安州團練使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he was made Training Commissioner of An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qingning he was made training commissioner of An Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大康中，歷懷德軍節度使、奚六部禿裏太尉。

translations.literal: During Dakang, he successively held the posts of Military Commissioner of the Huaide Army and Grand Commandant Tuli of the Six Xi Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: During Dakang he served in turn as military commissioner of the Huaide army and as grand commandant tuli of the Six Xi Tribes.

sentences.zh: 詔與樞密官措畫東北邊事，改左護衛太保。

translations.literal: He was ordered with privy council officials to plan northeastern frontier affairs and was made Senior Guard Commissioner of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to work with privy council officials on northeastern frontier strategy and was made senior commissioner of the left guard.

sentences.zh: 侍上，言多率易，察無他腸，以故上優貸之。

translations.literal: In attendance on the emperor his speech was often blunt and unguarded; investigation showed no ulterior motives, and for this reason the emperor treated him leniently.
translations.idiomatic: In the emperor's presence he spoke bluntly and without ceremony; inquiry showed no hidden designs, and for that reason the throne treated him with indulgence.

sentences.zh: 大安八年，知西北路招討使事。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Da'an, he was made commander of Northwestern Route campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: In Da'an 8 he took charge of northwestern route frontier campaigns.

sentences.zh: 時邊部耶睹刮等來侵，何魯掃古誘北阻卜酋豪磨古斯攻之，俘獲甚眾，以功加左僕射。

translations.literal: At that time the frontier tribes Yeduogua and others invaded; Helusaogu induced the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi to attack them, taking many captives, and for his merit was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: When the frontier tribes led by Yeduogua raided the border, Helusaogu induced the Northern Zubu chieftain Mogusi to strike them, took a great haul of captives, and was promoted to left vice director for his service.

sentences.zh: 復討耶睹刮等，誤擊磨古斯，北阻卜由是叛命。

translations.literal: Campaigning again against Yeduogua and others, he mistakenly struck Mogusi, and the Northern Zubu therefore rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On a renewed campaign against Yeduogua and his allies he mistakenly attacked Mogusi, and the Northern Zubu thereupon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 遣都監張九討之，不克，二室韋與六院部、特滿群牧、宮分等軍俱陷於敵。

translations.literal: Commissioner Zhang Jiu was dispatched to subdue them but failed; the two Shiwei divisions together with the Six Yuan Divisions, Temun Herd Office, Garrison Division, and other forces all fell to the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The overseer Zhang Jiu was sent to suppress them but failed; the two Shiwei divisions, together with the Six Yuan Division, the Temun herd office, the palace garrison troops, and other units, were all lost to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 何魯掃古不以實聞，坐是削官，決以大杖。

translations.literal: Helusaogu did not report the truth; for this his office was stripped and he was sentenced to heavy beating.
translations.idiomatic: Helusaogu failed to report what had really happened; for that his offices were stripped and he was sentenced to a heavy beating.

sentences.zh: 壽隆間，累遷惕隱，兼侍中，賜保節功臣。

translations.literal: During Shoulong he was repeatedly promoted to Tiyin, concurrently Vice Director, and granted the title Meritous Minister who Preserves Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: During Shoulong he rose through several posts to tiyin and vice director, and was granted the title of meritous minister who preserves integrity.

sentences.zh: 道宗崩，與宰相耶律儼總山陵事。

translations.literal: When Daozong died, he together with Chancellor Yelu Yi oversaw the imperial tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong died, he and the chancellor Yelu Yi jointly directed the imperial tomb works.

sentences.zh: 乾統中，致仕，卒。

translations.literal: During Qiantong he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qiantong he retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律世良，小字斡，六院部人。

translations.literal: Yelu Shiliang, childhood name Wo, was a man of the Six Yuan Division.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Shiliang, known in youth as Wo, came from the Six Yuan Division.

sentences.zh: 才敏給，練達國朝典故及世譜。

translations.literal: Talented and quick-witted, versed in dynastic precedents and genealogies.
translations.idiomatic: Quick-witted and capable, he had mastered the court's precedents and the imperial genealogies.

sentences.zh: 上書與族弟敵烈爭嫡庶，帝始識之。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial disputing with his clansman Dilie over legitimacy of birth; the emperor first took notice of him.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial disputing legitimacy of birth with his clansman Dilie, and the emperor first took notice of him.

sentences.zh: 時北院樞密使韓德讓病，帝問：「孰可代卿？」

translations.literal: At that time Northern Privy Council Director Han Derang was ill; the emperor asked: "Who can replace you?"
translations.idiomatic: When the northern privy council director Han Derang fell ill, the emperor asked, "Who can take your place?"

sentences.zh: 德讓曰：「世良可。」

translations.literal: Derang said: "Shiliang will do."
translations.idiomatic: Derang answered, "Shiliang will do."

sentences.zh: 北院大王耶律室魯復問北院之選，德讓曰：「無出世良。」

translations.literal: Northern Great King Yelu Shilu again asked about the Northern selection; Derang said: "No one surpasses Shiliang."
translations.idiomatic: The northern great king Yelu Shilu asked again who should lead the northern court; Derang said, "No one stands above Shiliang."

sentences.zh: 統和末，為北院大王。

translations.literal: At the end of Tonghe he became Northern Great King.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tonghe he was made northern great king.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，因大冊禮，加檢校太尉、同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaitai, on the occasion of the great enthronement rites, he was made Honorary Grand Commandant and Associate Director of the Directorate for Affairs of State.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaitai, on the great enthronement ceremony, he was made honorary grand commandant and associate director of the directorate for state affairs.

sentences.zh: 時邊部拒命，詔北院樞密使耶律化哥將兵，以世良為都監，往禦之。

translations.literal: At that time the frontier tribes refused obedience; the emperor ordered Northern Privy Council Director Yelu Huage to lead troops, with Shiliang as chief overseer, to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: When frontier tribes defied orders, the court ordered the northern privy council director Yelu Huage to take the field, with Shiliang as chief overseer, to repel them.

sentences.zh: 明年，化哥還，將罷兵，世良上書曰：「化哥以為無事而還，不思師老糧乏，敵人已去，焉能久守？

translations.literal: The next year Huage returned and was about to withdraw the army; Shiliang submitted a memorial saying: "Huage thinks there is nothing amiss and returns, without considering that the army is weary and provisions scarce; the enemy has already gone—how can they be held long?
translations.idiomatic: The following year Huage returned and was about to disband the army; Shiliang memorialized, "Huage thinks all is well and comes home, heedless of our weary troops and empty stores; the enemy has only withdrawn—how can they be held at bay for long?

sentences.zh: 若益兵，可克也。」

translations.literal: If troops are increased, they can be conquered."
translations.idiomatic: Reinforce the army and they can still be defeated."

sentences.zh: 帝即命化哥益兵，與世良追之。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately ordered Huage to reinforce the army and pursue together with Shiliang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at once ordered Huage to add troops and pursue with Shiliang.

sentences.zh: 至安真河，大破而還。

translations.literal: Reaching the Anzhen River, they won a great victory and returned.
translations.idiomatic: At the Anzhen River they won a crushing victory and returned.

sentences.zh: 自是邊境以寧。

translations.literal: From then on the frontier was at peace.
translations.idiomatic: From that time the frontier was calm.

sentences.zh: 以功王岐，拜北院樞密使。

translations.literal: For his merit he was enfeoffed Prince of Qi and appointed Northern Privy Council Director.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was enfeoffed as prince of Qi and appointed northern privy council director.

sentences.zh: 三年，命選馬駝於烏古部。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was ordered to select horses and camels from the Ugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of his tenure he was ordered to levy horses and camels from the Ugu tribe.

sentences.zh: 會敵烈部人夷剌殺其酋長稍瓦而叛，鄰部皆應，攻陷巨母古城。

translations.literal: When Yila of the Dilie tribe killed his chieftain Shaowa and rebelled, neighboring tribes all responded, and they captured and overran Jumu Old City.
translations.idiomatic: Then Yila of the Dilie tribe murdered his chieftain Shaowa and rose in revolt; neighboring tribes joined him and they stormed Jumu Old City.

sentences.zh: 世良率兵壓境，遣人招之，降數部，各復故地。

translations.literal: Shiliang led troops to press the border, sent men to summon them; several tribes submitted and each recovered their former territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang marched to the border, sent envoys to win them over, and several tribes submitted and were restored to their former lands.

sentences.zh: 四年，伐高麗，為副部署。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, campaigning against Goryeo, he served as deputy deployment commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the campaign against Goryeo, he served as deputy deployment commissioner.

sentences.zh: 都統劉慎行逗留失期，執還京師，世良獨進兵。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Liu Shenxing delayed and missed the rendezvous; he was seized and sent back to the capital, and Shiliang advanced alone.
translations.idiomatic: The commander-in-chief Liu Shenxing lingered and missed the rendezvous; he was arrested and sent back to the capital, and Shiliang pressed forward alone.

sentences.zh: 明年，至北都護府，破追兵於郭州。

translations.literal: The next year, reaching the Northern Capital Protectorate, he defeated pursuing troops at Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he reached the northern capital protectorate and routed pursuing troops at Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以暴疾卒。

translations.literal: He died suddenly of acute illness.
translations.idiomatic: He died suddenly of a violent illness.

sentences.zh: 論曰：大之懷小也以德，制之也以威。

translations.literal: Commentary says: The great wins over the small through virtue and controls them through might.
translations.idiomatic: The historian remarks: The great win the loyalty of the small through virtue and restrain them through might.

sentences.zh: 德不足懷，威不足制，而欲服人也難矣。

translations.literal: When virtue is insufficient to win hearts and might insufficient to control, wishing to make people submit is difficult indeed.
translations.idiomatic: When virtue is too thin to win hearts and might too weak to enforce obedience, making others submit is hard indeed.

sentences.zh: 化哥利俘獲，而諸蕃不附，何魯掃古誤擊磨古斯，而阻卜叛命，是皆喜於一旦之功，而不圖後日之患，庸何議焉。

translations.literal: Huage coveted captives yet the various fan did not attach themselves; Helusaogu mistakenly struck Mogusi and the Zubu rebelled—these all delighted in momentary achievement without planning for later troubles; what is there to praise?
translations.idiomatic: Huage prized captives while the frontier tribes would not attach themselves; Helusaogu struck Mogusi by mistake and the Zubu rebelled—these men rejoiced in a single day's gain and gave no thought to tomorrow's trouble; what is there to commend?

sentences.zh: 若斡臘之戒深入，速撒之務安集，亦鐵中之錚錚者邪？

translations.literal: Yet if Wola's caution against deep penetration and Susa's work to pacify and gather—are these not the ringing iron among iron?
translations.idiomatic: Yet are not Wola, who warned against pushing too deep, and Susa, who labored to settle the tribes, the true steel among iron?
